summary: The edition has 105 complete guides and 16 screened discoveries. It completes 27 earlier pending guides and details 1 substantive release updates. Code grants were read in full. Models, services, creative inputs and hardware or software hosts have separate requirements. This edition is based on source review and published documentation. No discovered app was installed or run. The expanded plan covered 67 fields, 434/434 repository-query attempts and 24 model tasks. The repository lane recorded 434 successful, 0 partial and 0 failed queries, with 100 bounded. The model lane recorded 1 failed tasks. Metadata from 570 saved repository pages included 19,584 numeric identities. The complete retained backlog spans 126,598 candidates, including pilot history and 1,043 previously screened guides still pending before this edition. Creative relevance and the complete software grant were checked before including any discovery. Unreviewed and excluded records stay in local research. One advertised Blender texture extension had a license text in its documentation repository, but no matching implementation there. The separate download could not be verified as covered by that grant and stays outside the edition. The reviewed AI Score Studio CLI defines a rule-based notation example. Its model-backed workflows remain on the roadmap, so the package stays outside the edition. Live primary research yielded 480 complete usable responses from 544 distinct URL attempts, including a non-GitHub source in each of 67 fields. 2 captures reached the size bound and 62 other sources were inaccessible or unusable. The ecosystem checks cover all 8 configured groups and record available findings and gaps. Evidence labels in this edition are 0 Recommended, 0 Ready to try, 106 Quality unverified, 15 Experimental. Independent use remains unverified for 115 entries. The creative result check remains unverified for 120, and model, service or cost requirements remain unverified for 121. Repository searches returned no saved rows for Learned film, tape and audio restoration, Embodied and tactile interactive art, Multiband art and heritage imaging, Narrated and tactile exhibition interfaces, Learned shot matching and grading. Primary web research for these fields is included in the coverage notes. Updated evidence labels for previous entries: VeneraX (Quality unverified to Experimental), Comic Translation (Quality unverified to Experimental), 8f4e (Quality unverified to Experimental), PhotoCraft AI Diffusion (Quality unverified to Experimental), 3D Filmmaking Multimodal Evals (Experimental to Quality unverified). 23 model tasks reached the configured response limit of 50 rows. A model record remains a discovery lead until code and use are verified. Direct candidate source captures covered 214 identities. This edition includes 31 tools first retained by the historical pilot. Initial captures awaiting full source assessment and unsuccessful source attempts remain in local research. Model search gaps: text-to-image. The field notes identify the separate primary-source follow-up. All saved model-task results were screened as metadata, covering 1,150 rows and 1,150 distinct model identities. The separate watchlist made 71 unsuccessful repository checks. Collection logged 1 enrichment failures. Credential-shaped material in unsealed captures was removed before sealing. The affected source origins and before-and-after hashes remain in private evidence.

Generated clips still need looping, trim and import checks inside the game engine. Keep editable sound sources and engine-ready copies.

Pose inference and animation authoring generate different intermediate data. Check rotation, contact and frame cadence before retargeting. 1 direct source attempts for this field were unavailable, bounded or unusable.

The Blender lip-sync extension uses Vosk speech models and can produce editable keys. Select the model for the dialogue language and inspect consonants after baking.

The light-aware compositing authors describe carrying image-dependent lighting into a composite. The related capture literature scopes where learned geometric estimates come from. Lighting-aware compositing and coarse learned geometry require shot-specific checks. Keep separate lighting, matte and source layers for revision.

Neural view synthesis depends on a set of consistent views. Keep original cameras and an interchange copy of the learned scene. 1 direct source attempts for this field were unavailable, bounded or unusable.

Agent-directed edits need a transferable timeline. Reopen cuts in the finishing editor to check source-media relinking and timebase. 15 direct source attempts for this field were unavailable, bounded or unusable.

Vector model output can contain difficult paths or raster layers. Inspect editable curves, fill orientation and text before print export.

Counterpunch documents an optional assistant inside a glyph editor. FontForge documents editable glyph and font data for comparing what the assistant produces. The assistant in a font editor can aid glyph scripting. Maintain editable font sources and check spacing, script coverage and extrema.

The Drama AI project’s creative scope includes scene planning. CozyClay documents a stage where blocking and camera choices stay revisable. Separate scene planning from final renders. A creator can retain shots, actor blocking and source prompts as editable decisions.

The document-parser package describes structured extraction from source pages. The local caption package exposes the separate speech-timing route for editorial media. Structure extraction and speech timestamps can support editorial handoff. Proof reading order and text identity before publication.

Review timed text and relevant visual events separately. 2 direct source attempts for this field were unavailable, bounded or unusable.

MIRA documents multiband registration for heritage photography. Its development process alone does not establish end-user AI inference. Preserve registration references when pairing scans with learned transcription.

The spatial plugin documents ambisonic and binaural output routes. Neural generation upstream and decoder compatibility downstream require independent checks.

SoundSpaces documents geometrical simulation of acoustics. Scene2Sound presents a learned approach to assigning sound to visual scene objects. Scene-conditioned sound design can use learned generation or spatial simulation. Keep coordinates and generated audio as separate authoring controls.

The Blender extension registry describes phoneme animation. The web hand-landmarker guide describes a separate control signal for expressive puppets. Landmark and speech-driven workflows produce different puppet controls. Verify behavior during occlusion and silence before live use.

FreeMoCap’s maintainer documentation describes processing synchronized multi-camera recordings. Its context makes calibration and downstream retargeting explicit. Multi-camera pose capture depends on calibration and visible actors. Keep camera and skeleton data for checking retargeted movement.

Relo presents an agent-directed video assembly workflow. OpenTimelineIO supplies a documented interchange target against which to check time and source links. Store model-assisted cut decisions on an editable timeline with original clips. Verify handles, timebase and relinking after the first export. 2 direct source attempts for this field were unavailable, bounded or unusable.

Cornell and the companion package document learned bird-call identification and timestamps, which a sound artist can use as an index into source recordings. Learned acoustic labels can index long field recordings. Keep confidence and offsets and review rare events against the original clip.

ZKM’s Beyond Matter release describes mixed exhibition contexts. W3C’s description guidance gives a separate specification for the accessible media inside an exhibit. ZKM documents a hybrid exhibit staging workflow. W3C describes separate visual description choices. An editable exhibition needs source records and accessible narration.

FormDAM documents searchable photo collections. Pelli presents a culling workflow that can be evaluated on a fixed copy of an existing shoot. Model-assisted proofing ranks or retrieves photos. Review decisions on a copy of the shoot and keep the original catalog and ratings available.

SVG’s path and transform rules give an editable target for a learned segmentation or vectorization stage. Record which shapes remain raster before preparing a print plate. Inspect a learned vector result at output size. Check path continuity, fills and lettering before splitting the art into separations.

OpenTryOn exposes learned visualization of garments on people. Seamly provides a documented stage for construction outlines and measurements. Keep authored measurements separate from generated try-on previews. Fit and sewing allowances depend on the editable pattern.

3DCraft’s examples show a model-assisted route to parametric shape creation. ParCAD documents a separately editable solid model. Use measurable parametric outputs as the handoff from model-assisted form ideas. Validate unit, fit and toolchain before fabrication. 1 direct source attempts for this field were unavailable, bounded or unusable.

An editable stage and camera model from the cited authoring materials can retain blocking. OSSIA documents a separate rehearsal playback timeline. Keep staging and camera previs editable and rehearse cue timing against a live clock. Scope any learned motion feature to its documented route.

The documented mobile captioning route can supply timed review text. A device-specific listing does not guarantee the same media import or export behavior on another platform. Export short review material and separate timed text when possible. Confirm each mobile and desktop route explicitly.

Keep chapter text, narration settings and rendered audio separate. Review pronunciation and chapter transitions with the source manuscript.

Both are research evidence; their paper or project page alone does not verify a redistributable software implementation. ecosystem_checks.finding: Eight named searches returned first pages. Five met the 25-row bound; their second pages returned 25 each for Whisper, media editor and Blender AI, 14 for photogrammetry and 19 for audio transcription. Direct review verified local speech routes in MediaMultiTeka and Zimu. EchoTranscribe and Subtitld identify GitHub as their current source or package upstream.

The six public directory searches returned HTTP 429. Direct project reads returned the latest Facetracker release and complete MIT license as well as ASR Subtitles documentation. The attempted ASR Subtitles license path returned HTTP 404. Broad Codeberg discovery remains incomplete.

Six directory searches returned public pages. The diffusion search shows the earlier Diffuser lead, whose current Cargo configuration still refers to a local dependency path. The speech search surfaced WhisperUI. The public tree contains Rust and Tauri files but no complete software grant was found in the main or master paths inspected.

F-Droid lists a Whisper speech recognizer for Android. The Subtitld package metadata records the editor release distributed through PyPI. PyPI’s Partitura and pyfar pages document symbolic score handling and room-acoustic signal processing.

The current Blender extension search surfaces compositor denoising add-ons. The registry also documents Vosk-driven facial keyframes in Lip Sync. ComfyUI maintains a separate registry for node workflows where each code grant and model choice needs individual review.

Cue publishes an editable AI-assisted Mac video timeline and example assets for reviewing its cut workflow. XianScan publishes a concrete manga-text localization route and Koharu describes the typesetting step. Existing tools did not qualify for re-listing on this evidence.

Primary papers describe diffusion-assisted tactile design, novel acoustic views and inverse material estimation. The project-specific source review retained the MIT SRERS research implementation for a later full profile. A paper or model-card grant was insufficient for software eligibility.

Polish MediaMultiTeka documentation describes local speech recognition and an optional Bielik summarizer. Japanese and Chinese comic workflows provide independent documentation for checking OCR language, local model selection and manual lettering.
